body:
About once a year (maybe twice) I have to relearn my cathinone lesson. These things just arent good for, tend to lead to compulsive redosing, and just end up leaving a vile flavor of the experience.
Around 7:45am I ate around 100 mg and snorted another 150 mg of butylone. By 8am I was feeling pretty good and jerking off to porn by 8:30 am. More similar to methylone than MDMA, and the euphoria part is about as short-lived. By 9:30am I was in a comedown phase, took a warm bath, and watched TV, settling into an ugly long-lasting anxiety.
Most cathinones have similar effects on me (and probably others)  they start out beautiful but turn to shit at some point
they start out beautiful but turn to shit at some point
, leaving me with high blood pressure, anxiety, paranoia, and possibly peeking out the windows for hours on end. More disturbing was a shortness of breath and heavy feeling in my chest and stomach, which may be signs of a heart attack.
My state of anxiety lasted beyond 1pm, at which point I slowed the roll with some etizolam and later had a few beers. Fourteen hours later, my system still feels toxic but well get past it. I dont remember methylone or even ethylone feeling this dirty on the backside. Now that I think about it, I dont remember butylone feeling this dirty either (but that was back in 2011ish and I didnt keep terribly good notes at the time).
That said and while theyre fresh on my mind, Ill be badmouthing cathinones until the next time I forget the consequences and decide theyd be a good idea. Sort of like I did yesterday.
